title: A new benchmark for long-horizon agentic AI reasoning
tldr: A new evaluation framework measures agents on planning, tool use, and recovery — and finds frontier models still degrade on long tasks.

title: Open-source retrieval stacks narrow the gap on enterprise RAG
tldr: Hybrid sparse-plus-dense retrieval and graph stores are closing the quality gap with proprietary RAG pipelines.

title: Bayesian policy selection using active inference
tldr: This paper introduces active inference as a unified framework for action selection in artificial agents, grounded in the free energy principle from neuroscience. By framing policy selection as Bayesian inference, it demonstrates how active inference can subsume both reinforcement learning and learning from demonstrations, offering a more principled and sample-efficient alternative to traditional RL approaches.

title: Meta adds AI screening to detect WhatsApp scams
tldr: Meta is rolling out an optional on‑device AI feature called Scam Alert for WhatsApp that flags suspicious messages without sending content off the phone, giving users the choice to block, report, or trust a chat. The move aims to curb billions in losses from WhatsApp‑based scams while preserving user privacy.

title: Myanmar's digital economy: connectivity grows while governance lags
tldr: Mobile-first finance and connectivity expand across Myanmar, but unclear data-governance rules cap foreign technology partnerships.
